Profile

I am a master's student at Southeast University. Previously, I studied at Lanzhou University (2021–2026).

My current research interests center on 3D Gaussian Splatting, Neural Rendering, and Real-time Computer Graphics. In particular, I am interested in:

  • 3D Gaussian Splatting and learned scene representations
  • Neural rendering and efficient real-time rendering techniques
  • Applications of computer graphics in games and interactive systems

I am interested in combining learned scene representations with traditional rendering techniques to create efficient, high-quality graphics for games and interactive applications.

For academic correspondence, please contact me at 220262267@seu.edu.cn.

The Visual Computer

An automatic framework for quadrilateral surface reconstruction with partitions from 3D point cloudsShuyang Zhu · Youlong Li · Jizhao Liu · Bin Li

  • Reconstructs partitioned quadrilateral surfaces directly from 3D point clouds using a skeleton-guided, four-stage framework.
  • Recovers fine surface details while preserving meaningful part-based partitions.
